title: AI-Powered Customer Service System
shortDesc: Facial recognition and service automation system for Union Bank

content.objective: The goal is to design and implement a highly accurate facial recognition system that can authenticate and accept customer service queries via video/audio recordings and create appointments for customer support. The system should streamline the process for both new and existing customers, while enhancing security, fraud prevention, and customer experience. The solution needs to provide a service ticket with a detailed analytical snapshot of the customer's profile and direct customers to the right business unit based on their needs.
coreComponents: AI-Powered Risk Mitigation and Data Gathering
Cost-Effective and Deployable to Rural Branches

existingCustomer: Vatsalya is an existing customer of the Union Bank Of India and needs assistance with a loan query. He opens the mobile banking app of Union Bank, Vyom and is prompted by the Union Bank’s Chatbot UVA to record a short video explaining his question.
The facial recognition system authenticates his identity using the facial model stored in the app, along with his Aadhaar-based authentication.

The system creates a service ticket and pulls an analytical snapshot of Vatsalya’s financial profile, highlighting his credit score, previous loan applications, and spending habits. Based on this data, the system suggests a loan option with the relevant details.
Vatsalya receives an appointment confirmation for a video call with a customer service representative to discuss the loan options further.
newCustomer: A new customer, Ravi, downloads the Union Bank Of India’s mobile app Vyom and begins the onboarding process. He uploads his Aadhaar and PAN card details.
The system fetches information from these records, assesses Ravi’s financial background, and routes him to the loan department because his profile indicates he is interested in a housing loan.
Ravi’s service ticket is generated with an analytical snapshot that includes his credit score, income, and potential eligibility for various loan options.
Ravi is then directed to the loan officer, who receives the ticket with personalized suggestions for Ravi based on the data.

expectedSolution: The solution should integrate a face training model within the Union bank of India’s mobile app Vyom for fraud prevention, utilizing AADHAAR-based authentication to verify customer identities and enable edge processing. This will ensure secure transactions and minimize identity fraud risks, even in remote areas.

A feedback module should generate AI-driven suggestions for branches and staff, analyzing customer interactions and transaction patterns to enhance service quality and deriving actionable insights for better customer service and resource allocation.

title: Phishing Domain Takedown System
shortDesc: Streamlined process for handling cybersecurity threats

description: Many times, it is observed that not all domain registrars or hosting providers are cooperative when it comes to requests for phishing domain takedowns, especially if they operate in jurisdictions where state actors or threat actors benefit from relaxed cybersecurity laws. Public Sector Banks (PSBs) in India face significant challenges in the timely takedown of suspicious, malicious, or phishing domains impersonating their entities.

In several instances, third-party takedown service providers have been unable to successfully remove such phishing domains or fraudulent applications. Furthermore, there is an absence of a well-defined, centralized mechanism provided by any authority to address these issues. Specifically, difficulties arise in identifying a single point of contact or department responsible for handling such cases, as well as a lack of clear guidelines on how to proceed with these requests.
This often leads to delays in resolving these threats, potentially compromising the security of customers.
content.exampleScenario: Arnav, a cybersecurity specialist at a Union Bank Of India, discovers a phishing website impersonating their bank. The fraudulent website is collecting sensitive customer information, posing a significant threat. Despite contacting third-party takedown service providers, the domain remains active due to non-cooperation from the registrar, located in a jurisdiction with lax cybersecurity regulations. This delay risks exposing customer data and eroding trust in the institution.

expectedSolution.title: Streamlined Takedown Processes
points: A clear and efficient mechanism for reporting phishing domains and fraudulent applications to the right stakeholders.
Templates or guidelines for PSBs to escalate and follow up on takedown requests from the appropriate Government authority.

expectedSolution.title: Centralized Coordination
points: A centralized platform or framework to ensure coordination among banks, government, cybersecurity experts, and service providers.
Efficient coordination facilitation between the right department and the Bank.
Mechanisms to overcome jurisdictional challenges and non-cooperative registrars.

title: GenAI Financial Crime Prevention
shortDesc: AI-powered system for detecting and preventing financial fraud

content.description: With the rise of digital banking, financial institutions face an increasing threat of financial crimes like money laundering and fraud. This document explores how Generative AI (GenAI) can help address these challenges through large-scale data analysis to provide real-time, actionable insights. Hypothetical use cases involving individuals like Naman and Arnav illustrate practical applications.
financialInstitutionsStruggleWith: High false-positive rates in fraud detection

realLifeExample.fraudulentActivityDetection: Naman receives a large sum from an unfamiliar account, and subsequent international transactions are flagged as 'smurfing' (money laundering), freezing the account for review.
realLifeExample.personalizedServices: GenAI notices Naman’s frequent foreign transactions and recommends a travel-friendly credit card.
realLifeExample.insiderThreatPrevention: GenAI detects unauthorized access to Naman’s transaction history by an employee and alerts the compliance team.

expectedSolution.title: Customer Analytics
points: Analyzing Customer Behavior: GenAI identifies unusual spending patterns.
Predicting Banking Trends: GenAI forecasts emerging trends by analyzing real-time data.
Personalized Services: GenAI tailors services to customers based on financial habits.

expectedSolution.title: Insider Threats and Fraud Detection
points: Identifying Anomalies: GenAI flags deviations in user activity.
Recognizing Fraud Patterns: GenAI detects sophisticated fraud patterns.
Detecting Insider Threats: GenAI monitors employee actions to identify malicious activities.

expectedSolution.title: Customer Profiling and Onboarding
points: Implement AI-driven identity verification models for dynamic customer profiling, ensuring accurate risk assessments.
Simplify onboarding by utilizing AADHAAR-based authentication and real-time data processing for seamless registration while complying with regulatory requirements.

expectedSolution.title: Complex Transaction Networks
points: Use AI-powered transaction monitoring to analyze large-scale transaction networks and detect unusual patterns or fraudulent activities in real time.
Implement pattern recognition techniques to identify suspicious cross-network transactions and trigger alerts for further investigation.

expectedSolution.title: Cross-border Transactions
points: Apply GenAI models to flag cross-border transactions that deviate from usual patterns or involve high-risk countries.
Introduce transaction profiling to better detect money laundering or other illegal activities involving international payments.

expectedSolution.title: Short Lifespan Fraudulent Accounts
points: Deploy AI-based algorithms to detect rapid account creation, usage, and closure cycles, which are common in fraudulent activity.
Monitor accounts for abnormal behavior to flag and block potential fraud before accounts are deactivated.

expectedSolution.title: High False-Positive Rates in Fraud Detection
points: Integrate machine learning models that learn from historical data to refine fraud detection algorithms, reducing false-positive rates.
Develop context-aware systems that distinguish legitimate transactions from fraudulent ones based on customer profiles and historical activity.

expectedSolution.title: Advanced Evasion Techniques by Fraudsters
points: Use adaptive AI models capable of identifying evolving fraud tactics, including obfuscated transactions and synthetic identities.
Continuously update the fraud detection system with new data to counter advanced evasion techniques and fraudster methods.
